items.summary: A prompt-template sandbox escape in GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets an authenticated user with custom-flow privileges execute arbitrary commands on the self-hosted AI Gateway, exposing JWT signing keys and model-provider channels. Patch to 19.2.4, 19.3.2 or 19.4.1 immediately.

An authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager lets an unauthenticated remote attacker gain administrative API access through improper URI encoding handling. Cisco confirms exploitation was observed in September; patch regardless of configuration.

A path traversal in Fortinet FortiMail allows an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files to the system via crafted HTTP(S) requests. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 1 — verify vendor patch availability now.

A session-fixation flaw in Zammad lets an attacker hijack a session and run code as the zammad service account, chaining with CVE-2026-102490 (local root privesc) to own the host. The pair was used in the DIVD breach by an AI agent and both are in CISA KEV.

Atlassian's October 5 advisory warns of unauthenticated arbitrary file access in the web root of eight self-hosted Data Center products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible, Fisheye). Cloud instances are already patched; upgrade on-prem to the listed fixed releases.
